newsitem.title: USA: U.S. STOCK INDEX FUTURES FINISH NARROWLY MIXED.
newsitem.headline: U.S. STOCK INDEX FUTURES FINISH NARROWLY MIXED.

text.p: Aug 13 - U.S. stock index futures ended narrowly mixed, with Sept S&P 500 lower. After T-bond futures closed, afternoon S&P 500 gains eroded, traders said. Market tone nervous and choppy overall, traders await industrial output/capacity use and CPI on Thursday. Traders report scant conviction on either side of the market Wednesday.
